title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. translated_title: 修复失效之处：面向场景图生成的根因引导智能体框架优化
translated_abstract: 场景图生成（SGG）旨在检测图像中的物体并预测它们之间的关系。标准的PredCls、SGCls和SGDet设置只显示了在没有真实边界框和标签时性能下降的程度，但无法揭示模型在哪里或为什么失败。了解这一点将使我们能够在模型失败之处对其进行修复，而无需重新训练。我们提出了RoHa-SGG（面向SGG的根因引导框架优化），将智能体框架优化扩展到SGG领域。它优化的对象是框架，即围绕冻结SGG模型的推理代码。RoHa-SGG包含两个主要的LLM智能体：一个根因分析（RCA）智能体负责找出模型失败的组件并诊断原因，一个提议者智能体负责搜索能够修复这些原因的框架。我们在Visual Genome和PSG数据集上，使用具有代表性的两阶段、一阶段和多模态LLM SGG模型对RoHa-SGG进行评估。分析表明，真实三元组丢失的组件在不同模型之间存在差异（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了RoHa-SGG方法，利用根因分析智能体和提议者智能体两个LLM智能体来优化冻结SGG模型周围的推理框架代码，在模型失败之处进行针对性修复而无需重新训练。
